applies_to: Acutherm Advantage master diffusers (with drone diffusers slaved to them) fitted with the native BACnet option.
summary: The Advantage is a motorised VAV diffuser: each master unit has its own controller and wall thermostat and can drive up to five drone diffusers with a 0-10 V signal. With the optional native BACnet module each master is a BACnet MS/TP device; drones have no BACnet presence. The BMS overrides setpoint, room temperature and occupancy through the Net* objects rather than writing the room setpoint directly. All objects are AVs and AIs, with codes in place of binary or multistate objects.
notes: Every object is an AI or AV; occupancy, overrides and contact states are numeric codes in AVs.
AV 6 Room Setpoint is read-only over BACnet; write AV 28 Net Setpoint to change the setpoint from the BMS.
AI 8-9 are for the wireless thermostat; AI 10-11 need the CO2/humidity thermostat; AV 2-3 need the occupancy thermostat.
AV 41-44 apply only with the DMS airflow measurement option.
Acutherm marks the controller tuning AVs (AV 1, 15-17, 26, 32, 13, 45) as not to be changed without its approval.
Source title: Manual - List of BACnet Objects, Advantage Digital VAV Diffusers (v001, 12/29/21). Transport and addressing details come from the Advantage installation manual (Manual ADV 200).

integration.summary: Set each master's MAC (1-99) and device instance from the LCD thermostat, keep 76800 baud, then map the Net* override objects for occupancy and setpoint plus room temperature, load and damper position. Drones follow their master and are not on the network.

minimum_points.name: Net Occupancy
minimum_points.why: Occupancy: 0 normal, 1 force occ, 2 force unocc

integration.enable: No enable point. The BMS forces occupancy with AV 30 Net Occupancy (0 = Normal Operation, 1 = Force Occupied, 2 = Force Unoccupied) and sets the room setpoint through AV 28 Net Setpoint. AV 25 overrides the damper (0 = automatic) for balancing.
integration.remote_sensors: AV 29 Net Room Temp overrides the room temperature from the BACnet network (default 0). AV 31 Net Lights overrides the room lights output (0 = normal, 1 = on, 2 = off).
setup: BACnet MS/TP on the optional native BACnet module of each master diffuser; drones are not on the network.
MAC address 1-99, set by DIP switches or (recommended) from the LCD thermostat/setup tool, which overrides the switches.
Device instance defaults to 100 shown with the MAC as its last two digits (e.g. 101); set it from the LCD thermostat or setup tool.
Default baud 76800 (also 38400, 19200, 9600). BACnet settings are read only at startup; the controller restarts after a software change, a DIP change needs a power cycle.
Use twisted pair (CAT5 works) with NET COM connected at every device; 24 VAC polarity must match across the segment.
gotchas: AV 6 is read-only; writing the setpoint means writing AV 28 Net Setpoint.
AV 18 reads 999 while the damper recalibrates.
AV 25 damper override stays in force until set back to 0.
